videos.title: The IP owner
videos.blurb: Publish an authorised kit, review a creator’s proposal against it, and approve one exact version.

chapters.title: Start on the home page. Each person in the collaboration has their own login.
Choose Haruka Sato — the IP owner and the kit’s named approver.
Her overview: proposals waiting for a decision, her kit, and every collaboration.
The authorised kit: explicit rules for products, territory, dates, price band and approver.
Original artwork is uploaded here, then included in a published kit version.
Changing the rules publishes a new kit version. Earlier proposals keep the rules they were judged by.
The review screen shows the exact creative — before and after, generated from saved design data.
Every change since the last approved version is listed. Approval never carries over.
The creator’s contribution: audience, local angle and distribution plan.
Every declared rule is re-checked on the server before a decision.
Approve. Haruka’s decision is bound to this version’s fingerprint.
Approved — sealed with the version number and fingerprint. Any later edit needs fresh approval.

videos.title: The creator
videos.blurb: Get refused for an unlicensed product, build a new proposal inside the kit, use the brief assistant, submit, and publish.

chapters.title: Creators log in the same way. First, Kabir Shah of Panel Theory.
Kabir drafted a glassware product. The kit licenses only T-shirts and posters.
The server refuses the submission — and explains why in plain language.
Switch to Riya Menon, who runs 22 college anime clubs in Delhi NCR.
Riya’s studio: her campaigns, their versions, and preorder progress.
A private draft inside the kit’s latest rules. Rule checks run on the server as she edits.
Optional brief assistant: two directions built only from this kit’s artwork and templates.
Each suggestion is validated against the kit. Nothing is saved until Riya chooses.
Now make it hers: approved artwork, colour and her own print line. The preview updates live.
Her contribution beyond design: who it’s for and how fans will hear about it.
Price, production threshold and dates — with a live split of who earns what.
Submitted and locked, so the owner reviews exactly what was sent.
Midnight Delivery Tee v3 has been approved by Haruka. Riya publishes it.
Live. New orders get v3; everyone who bought v2 keeps v2.

videos.title: The fan
videos.blurb: Find an official campaign, preorder in test mode, pay through the simulator, and track the order.

chapters.title: Log in as Aarav Gupta, a Sky Courier fan in Patiala.
Official campaigns, each approved by the IP owner, with a production gate.
The campaign page: approved design, creator, price and deadline.
45 of 50 paid. Five more preorders unlock production.
Choose size and quantity. The full total is shown before paying.
Test-mode payment simulator: clearly labelled, no real money moves.
Payment confirmed by a signed webhook on the server. The production gate is reached.
Every payment event Torii received is listed here.
Resending the same event is recognised as a duplicate. The order is counted once.
Aarav’s orders. Each keeps the exact design version he paid for.

videos.title: The Torii operator
videos.blurb: Release production, ship and deliver, prove idempotency, cancel and refund a missed run, and read the statement.

chapters.title: Log in as Meera Iyer from Torii operations.
Every campaign, with anything that needs a decision flagged.
Midnight has passed its gate: 50 of 50 paid. Release it to production.
Ship, then deliver. Earnings are written to the ledger only on delivery.
Replaying every payment event: all recognised as duplicates, ledger unchanged.
Monsoon Route Poster missed its deadline at 13 of 40. Cancel and refund.
Every paid order refunded exactly once. Running it again changes nothing.
The statement. ₹69,900 net item sales on 100 delivered units.
Licensor ₹6,990 · creator ₹5,592 · Torii ₹8,388 — revenue before expenses, not profit.
Ledger totals are recomputed from orders and checked — including the refunds.
Cost assumptions are kept apart from recorded figures. Every number links to its orders.
Export the statement as CSV for partners.
